summary: Added the Ember and Smoke kits to the pure duel. Content: DuelMoveset.kits, an explicit move `effect` (strike/projectile/zone/feint), optional projectile/zone/cancel sub-objects, strikesWithHitbox, FEINT_REAPPEARANCE_FRAMES=12, kitBudgetIssues named checks, and emberMoves/smokeMoves in the new kits.ts; duelistMoveset moved to the new moveset.ts. MOVESET_VERSION changed 248675b2a680c2c7 -> a32af270c3979db5 (pin updated in determinism.test.ts). Simulation: FighterState gains kit, bolt, zone and obscured; U/I read the fighter's kit; swept, symmetric bolt resolution (melee priority, bolt beats grab, block along travel, invulnerability ignores bolts, bolts cancel, no owner pushback); feint cancel into normals only from frame 25; smoke screen marks fighters; restoreDuel checks kit moves, slots and bolt-event ids; fighterTells lists what the renderer must show. Tests: mirror.test.ts (golden per-frame hashes of 3 Duelist mirrors, 9,140 frames, recorded at base commit 4c90df5 from an extraction outside the repo), ember/smoke/matchups tests (scripted matchups for 5 pairs, 2,400-frame random property runs with JSON snapshot round trips of every state, replay, rollback mid-bolt and mid-screen, symmetry), and content kit tests. docs/fruit-kits.md written. Run locally from this worktree: npm run typecheck, npm run test:unit (630 passed), npm run test:integration (36 passed), npm run build (smoke passed). I ran npm ci once at the start, not again from a clean checkout at the end.
open_assumptions: The Duelist mirror's golden inputs come from a seeded random policy that also reacts to the state (guarding, grab escapes, follow-ups), using only fields that existed before the kits. The task says 'random-input'. I chose this over pure random input, which gave only 2 blocks in 6,000 frames.

Frame data (bolt recovery 40, flare 9/6/34, feint 10/2/18 with the cancel from frame 25, screen 180 frames) is my choice within §8/§9. Punishing a jumped bolt with a heavy needs the jump by about the cast's 5th frame, which is a read of the cast rather than a reaction.

Rules §9 leaves open, chosen and documented in docs/fruit-kits.md: a projectile or zone special cannot start while that fighter's bolt or screen is out; a smoke screen marks every fighter inside it, the caster included; on a throw-break frame a bolt contact does not apply and the bolt flies on; the flare is a high (crouchers avoid it); the feint dashes forward only.
docs/duel.md is not updated (not owned); the operator merges docs/fruit-kits.md's state, step-order and version sections into it.
untested: The golden mirror traces reach few combos of 3 or more hits: a mutation to 3rd-hit combo scaling is not caught by mirror.test.ts (duel.test.ts covers scaling directly).
Throw clashes and double KOs do not occur in the golden mirror traces (existing duel/determinism tests cover them).
The online path (DuelAuthority/DuelClientSession/DuelRoom) is not run with kits: rooms still create Duelist mirrors. Kit snapshots are round-tripped only through restoreDuel.
No renderer uses fighterTells or strikesWithHitbox yet (fruit-kits-online).
verify_yourself: That the golden data in packages/simulation/src/duel/mirror.test.ts really is the base commit's behaviour. It was recorded by a throwaway recorder, outside the repo, against a `git archive 4c90df5` extraction whose MOVESET_VERSION was checked to be 248675b2a680c2c7. Re-running that recorder, or `git stash`-free: checking out 4c90df5 elsewhere and stepping seeds 4, 9 and 26 with mirrorPlayers, should give the same hash strings.
